text: Steps get no project path: steps/vectors.py by_meaning and core/wordlists/folders.py both start from Path.cwd(), so a pipeline run with the project option may read models.dir or the project's lists from the wrong folder. A fix passes ctx.obj['project'] to the steps (pipeline change, outside SEMKIT-034).
note: A task of its own: Pipeline steps use the project of the CLI (created after v0.1.25)
